# AI conversation layer — hosted vs open-weight comparison

**STUB RUN.** This report was generated by `ai_service/scripts/eval_compare.py`
with the deterministic stub providers: no model server was contacted and no
credential exists on the authoring machine (non-negotiable 7). Every number
below is a mechanical measurement of the *pipeline* — latency shape, token
accounting and cost arithmetic — not a measurement of model quality. Do not
cite it as evidence about a real model's answers. The real run is task H15.

- Generated (UTC): 2026-10-16T11:27:45Z
- Suite: 150 AI guardrail cases through the real pipeline
- Content library: 92 chunks indexed (embedding mode `jsonb`, provider `stub`)
- Price sheet: `SISI_AI_PRICE_*` = 0.000 / 0.000 / 0.000 / 0.000 USD per 1,000 tokens — PLACEHOLDERS (A37), so the cost column is arithmetically correct and numerically zero
- Stub profiles differ only in per-call latency and model label; each case keeps
  the behaviour it declares, so guardrail routing is identical across profiles

red-flag urgent script are constant-time by construction and pull the all-case
mean down. A real run replaces the stub's sleep with network latency.

Stub answers are deterministic and non-semantic: they cannot tell anyone whether
the Kiswahili or Sheng wording is understandable, respectful or clinically safe.
A human must rate a real-model sample before this row carries any claim.

## How to run this with real models (H15)

1. Hosted model: SISI_AI_LLM_PROVIDER=hosted SISI_AI_HOSTED_API_KEY=<key> SISI_AI_HOSTED_MODEL=<model> (Anthropic-style POST {base}/v1/messages).
2. Open-weight model: serve the model on the GPU host and export
   SISI_AI_LLM_PROVIDER=openweight SISI_AI_OPENWEIGHT_BASE_URL=http://<gpu-host>:8000/v1 SISI_AI_OPENWEIGHT_MODEL=<model> (vLLM, OpenAI-compatible).
3. Fill the `SISI_AI_PRICE_*` sheet with the real per-1,000-token prices (A37),
   then rerun `python scripts/eval_compare.py` — it rewrites this report.
4. Have a Kiswahili/Sheng speaker rate a sample of the answers (fluency,
   respect, age-appropriateness) and replace the quality row above; the rating
   also decides whether the open-weight path is fit for the pilot.
5. Re-run `python scripts/eval_guardrails.py --ci` against each real provider
   before recording the result: the deterministic post-filter is the only
   CI-enforced backstop, and it must stay green on real models too.
